## Problem and change

Describe the problem and how this change addresses it. Link related issues.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots
where helpful. Note anything you could not verify.

## Risks and upgrade notes

Mention breaking changes, configuration or database changes, and any deployment
steps. Write "None" if not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and its contribution terms.
- [ ] I have run the checks relevant to the affected packages.
- [ ] I have updated documentation where needed.
- [ ] I have excluded credentials, private data, and unrelated generated files.
- [ ] I have preserved license notices and identified any third-party material.
